ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 40,800 brokerage clerks were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decrease to 36,900 by 2034, a net loss of about 3,900 jobs, with approximately 4,100 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $62,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI is systematically replacing the operational tasks of Brokerage Clerks. Automated order matching, robotic clearing and reconciliation, and intelligent account-opening reviews are digitizing standardized processes. The occupation will not disappear immediately, but headcount is shrinking. Remaining clerks are shifting toward systems operations, exception handling, and compliance control. AI runs the process; people manage exceptions.
ai_s2_auto: OCR and automated review of account-opening documents
Automated matching and confirmation of trade instructions
Robotic clearing and reconciliation processes
Automatic digital archiving of transaction records
ai_s3_list: Exception handling: people step in when systems cannot reconcile.
Compliance judgment: people identify and report red-line issues.
Cross-functional coordination: people connect front office, back office, clearing, and risk control.
Systems understanding: effective tool use requires knowledge of business logic.
Accountability: people take responsibility for errors and risks.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places Brokerage Clerks in the moderate-high AI-exposure tier among financial back-office roles. Automation excels at standardized account opening, data entry, clearing, and reconciliation, so purely operational roles are contracting sharply. Remaining workers must become operations professionals who understand systems and compliance and can handle exceptions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure is a clear signal to transform. Move beyond manual execution, use process automation and data tools, and progress toward clearing analysis, compliance assistance, or operations management. Back-office work will remain; purely operational work will not.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Finance remains worth entering, but do not target a back-office processing role. Combine finance with technology through financial technology or data analysis, earn securities-industry credentials during an undergraduate program, and target clearing analysis, compliance, or operations management roles that automation augments instead of replaces.

Move quickly from pure processing toward systems plus compliance. Learn clearing systems, robotic process automation, and data-analysis tools, then pursue clearing analysis, compliance assistant, or operations management roles. Advanced industry credentials can also offset shrinking headcount.

People with accounting, settlement, or customer-service experience can enter financial back-office work, but should choose carefully. Prioritize clearing, operations, and compliance-support roles. In interviews, emphasize accuracy, error rates, and systems experience instead of data entry alone.

Transform pure brokerage clerk positions into operations-support plus exception-handling roles, using automation so people can focus on judgment. Clear compliance and operations career paths retain employees who understand the business and cost less than repeated hiring.

ai_s7_trends: Account opening and clearing become fully automated, and purely operational roles continue to contract.
Back-office roles shift toward compliance, analysis, and operations management.
Demand rises for financial-technology talent, favoring multidisciplinary backgrounds.

body: Brokerage Clerks process transaction-related work in the back offices of securities firms, futures companies, banks, and other financial institutions. They open customer accounts and manage records, enter trade instructions, confirm executions, clear and settle transactions, reconcile and archive records, and prepare reports.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能秒级完成指令匹配和结算对账，但「这笔差异出在哪、合规上要不要上报」——后台的判断和担当，还得人来做。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年经纪文员在岗约 4.08 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.69 万人，岗位净减约 0.39 万个，年均产生约 0.41 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.29 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 正在系统性地替代经纪文员的操作环节：指令自动匹配、清算对账机器人、智能开户审核，把标准化流程全部数字化。岗位不会立刻清零，但数量在收缩，留下来的文员转向「系统运营、异常处理、合规把关」——AI 跑流程，人管例外。
ai_s2_accel: 合规审查 AI 辅助
ai_s2_auto: 开户资料 OCR 与自动审核
交易指令自动匹配确认
清算对账流程机器人
凭证电子化自动归档
ai_s3_list: 异常处理：系统跑不平的地方人顶上。
合规判断：红线事项识别与上报。
跨部门协调：前后台、清算、风控衔接。
系统理解：懂业务逻辑才能用好工具。
责任担当：差错与风险面前敢负责。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明经纪文员是「中高曝光」的金融后台岗位：开户、录入、清算、对账这些标准流程正是自动化最擅长吃掉的，纯操作型岗位收缩明显；留下来的人要向「懂系统、懂合规、会处理异常」的运营角色转型。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光是明确的转型信号：别再当「手动执行者」，把流程自动化、数据工具用起来，往清算分析、合规助理、运营管理走——后台岗位不会消失，消失的是纯操作。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 金融行业仍值得进，但别把「后台操作岗」当目标：建议孩子学金融+技术复合（金融科技、数据分析方向），本科考证券从业等证书，毕业直接瞄准清算分析、合规、运营管理这些被自动化「增强」而非替代的岗位。
尽快从「纯操作」转向「系统 + 合规」：把清算系统、流程机器人、数据分析工具学起来，往清算分析、合规助理、运营管理岗走；同时考更高级从业资格，用证书和技能对冲岗位收缩。
有会计、结算、客服背景的可以进金融后台，但要选对岗：优先投清算、运营、合规支持类岗位，面试突出细心、差错率和系统操作经验，别只强调「会录入」。
纯经纪文员岗建议转型为「运营支持 + 异常处理」角色，配好自动化工具让人做判断；给后台员工清晰的合规、运营晋升通道，留住懂业务的人，比反复招人划算。

ai_s7_trends: 开户清算全线自动化，纯操作岗持续收缩。
后台岗位向合规、分析、运营管理转型。
金融科技人才需求上升，复合背景吃香。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can chart national market prices in a minute, but only someone who inspects goods at their origin can judge the grade of a cotton lot and whether its price is negotiable.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 522,200 buyers and purchasing agents for farm products were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to increase to 552,300 by 2034, a net gain of about 30,100 jobs, with approximately 52,200 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $75,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Buyers And Purchasing Agents, Farm Products. Inspecting goods requires practical experience, price negotiation is a human contest, and origin relationships depend on long-term trust. AI processes market data, price comparisons, and documents efficiently, but machines cannot secure the right goods at the right price.
ai_s2_accel: AI market forecasts for decision support
ai_s2_auto: Automated collection and analysis of market data
Integration of price-comparison and quotation information
Digital contracts and transaction documents
Automatically generated purchasing ledgers and reports
ai_s3_list: Goods inspection: judge quality grades with eyes and hands.
Price negotiation: read the other party's limits.
Market sensitivity: sense price trends.
Origin relationships: maintain long-term trust.
Risk control: judge quality and payment risks.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10, moderate, means AI clearly affects procurement while people retain the core. Systems and AI increasingly handle market data, price comparisons, and documents. Inspection, negotiation, and relationship management remain the buyer's central value.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure requires advancement. Data platforms replace buyers who only visit origins and request quotes. Move toward category management by using AI data for decisions and experience for quality and risk control.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study agriculture, trade, or supply chains and add data-analysis skills. Procurement is not purely office work; it requires travel and endurance, while accumulated market knowledge and relationships have substantial value.

Build data-analysis ability, use forecasting and purchasing systems, and move toward category management. Specializing in one or two categories such as grain, cotton, or produce is more valuable than shallow breadth.
People with agricultural trade or wholesale-market experience transition easily. In interviews, describe categories handled, negotiation cases, and quantified savings.
Retain capable buyers through performance pay plus category authority. Give them market-data tools and decision rights so they become category operators rather than order runners.

ai_s7_trends: Data-driven category management replaces errand-based procurement.
Agricultural industrialization and concentrated supply chains increase procurement professionalism.
AI market forecasts and testing instruments assist decisions, while experience remains irreplaceable.

body: Buyers And Purchasing Agents, Farm Products source and purchase agricultural goods. They analyze markets, inspect quality, negotiate prices, sign contracts, and track logistics so organizations obtain acceptable raw materials at reasonable cost.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can chart national market prices in a minute, but only someone who inspects goods at their origin can judge the grade of a cotton lot and whether its price is negotiable.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能一分钟给出全国行情曲线，但「这批棉花到底几级、这个价谈不谈得下来」——只有蹲在产地、摸过货的人心里有底。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年采购员采购、农场产品在岗约 52.22 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 55.23 万人，净增约 3.01 万个岗位，年均产生约 5.22 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.57 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代农产品采购员：看货验货需要实际经验，价格谈判是人与人之间的博弈，产地关系更是长期维护出来的信任。AI 能高效处理行情数据、比价和文书，但「把货拿到手、拿到好价」这件事，机器替不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 行情预测辅助决策
传感器与仪器辅助品质检测
供应链数据全程可视化
ai_s2_auto: 行情数据自动采集分析
比价与询价信息整合
合同与单据电子化
采购台账与报表自动生成
ai_s3_list: 看货验货：凭眼手判断品质等级。
谈判议价：读懂对方底线的博弈。
行情敏感：价格走势的市场嗅觉。
产地人脉：长期信任的关系经营。
风险把控：质量与货款的风险判断。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明采购员处于「AI 明显介入、但核心靠人」的位置：行情数据、比价、文书正被系统和 AI 大幅接管，而看货、谈判、关系维护这些需要经验和人际的环节，依然是采购员的核心价值。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高分更要升级：只会「跑产地、问报价」的采购会被数据平台替代，往「品类经营」走——用 AI 数据辅助决策、用经验把控品质和风险，才是新一代采购的核心竞争力。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想干这行，读农学、经贸、供应链相关专业，多学点数据分析。要跟孩子讲清楚：采购不是坐办公室的活，要能跑产地、会吃苦，但积累的资源和行情经验很值钱。
把数据分析能力补起来：会用行情预测和采购系统，向品类经理发展。深耕一两个品类（谷物、棉花、果蔬），做专比做杂更值钱。
有农产品贸易、批发市场经验的人容易转。面试时重点讲你经手的品类、谈判案例和为公司省过多少钱，用数字说话最有说服力。
采购岗要用「绩效 + 品类授权」留住能人。给采购员配行情数据工具和决策权限，让他们从「跑腿下单」变成「品类经营者」。

ai_s7_trends: 数据驱动的品类经营取代纯跑腿采购。
农业产业化与供应链集中化提升采购专业性。
AI 行情预测与检测仪器辅助决策，但经验仍不可替代。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Remote diagnostics can flag failures early, but a servicer still determines which part failed, how to disassemble it, and how to calibrate it.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 32,500 coin, vending, and amusement machine servicers and repairers employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 31,600 by 2034, a net decrease of about 900 jobs, with about 3,500 openings per year. The 2026 median annual wage is about $47,400 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace this occupation, but it will shorten troubleshooting time. Remote diagnostics and self-tests identify routine faults early, shifting work from blind searches to precise part replacement, on-site calibration, and preventive maintenance. Workers who only clear simple jams face pressure, while those who read schematics and repair circuit boards become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Remote fault self-tests
Connected status reporting
Automatic return of jammed coins
Change-system self-tests
ai_s3_list: Disassembly and part replacement: human dexterity matters.
Reading circuit diagrams: human judgment matters.
On-site calibration: human precision matters.
Complex troubleshooting: human experience matters.
Client communication: people build trust.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places this occupation in the relatively low AI exposure tier. Hands-on disassembly and on-site calibration remain central and are difficult to automate, although remote diagnostics will continue to spread.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively low exposure does not mean high risk. Self-service systems replace basic jam clearing and resets, not skilled machine repair. Workers who read schematics and repair circuit boards become scarcer as equipment grows more sophisticated.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study basic electronics and mechanics. Simple jam-clearing work is shrinking, so build schematic-reading and circuit-board repair skills early.
Move beyond clearing jams by learning schematic reading, circuit-board repair, and preventive maintenance, then work toward responsibility for a service territory.
Highlight repair experience and an electrician certificate. Equipment vendors value reliable, fast service.
Do not hire on physical strength alone. Test schematic reading and troubleshooting skills, and pay a premium for technicians who can repair circuit boards.

ai_s7_trends: Remote diagnostics are spreading, reducing blind troubleshooting.
Smarter equipment raises the technical bar.
Circuit-board repair skills are in greater demand.

body: Coin, Vending, And Amusement Machine Servicers And Repairers install, maintain, and repair vending, change, and entertainment machines. They clear coin jams, restore network connections, resolve system freezes, calibrate change mechanisms, and keep equipment operating.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年自动售货、机器维修员在岗约 3.25 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.16 万人，岗位净减约 0.09 万个，年均产生约 0.35 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.74 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代这类岗位，但会压缩排障时间。远程诊断与自检把常规故障提前定位，人从「盲查」挪向「精准换件、现场调校、预防性保养」。真正被挤掉的是只做简单清卡的人，会读图、能修板的人更值钱。

联网状态上报
卡币自动回退
找零自检
ai_s3_list: 拆机换件：手感靠人。
电路读图：判断靠人。
现场调校：精度靠人。
疑难排查：经验靠人。
客户沟通：信任靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光——核心是动手拆装与现场调校，系统暂时难接手，但远程诊断会慢慢渗透。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「清卡与简单复位」动作，不是「拆机维修」的岗位。会读图、能修板的人，反而随设备智能化更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学电子与机械基础，纯清卡在缩，早点练读图和修板。
从「清卡」升级成「读图 + 修板 + 预防保养」，争取片区负责。
突出维修经验和电工证，设备商看重稳和快。
选人别只看体力，要看会不会读图和排障，能修板的骨干值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 远程诊断普及，盲查缩。
设备智能化抬高门槛。
会修板的人更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Smart meters can collect data automatically, but Energy Auditors still decide where heat escapes, which upgrades pay off, and how to persuade owners.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 147,600 Energy Auditors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 146,500 by 2034, a net loss of about 1,100 jobs, with about 14,800 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $72,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Energy Auditors, but it will accelerate data collection. Smart meters and AI analysis speed up measurement, shifting auditors from reading meters and calculating totals toward field judgment, retrofit recommendations, economic tradeoffs, and owner communication. Roles limited to data collection face the most pressure. Auditors who diagnose problems and persuade decision-makers become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Collect smart-meter data automatically
Calculate energy-use baselines automatically
Flag abnormal energy use
Automated Report Generation
ai_s3_list: Field judgment: people identify leaks.
Retrofit recommendations: people choose the tradeoffs.
Economic tradeoffs: people evaluate returns.
Owner communication: people persuade decision-makers.
Safety balance: people set the boundaries.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 indicates moderate-high exposure in energy-efficiency work. Systems accelerate data collection and reporting, but diagnosis and communication still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high job risk. Tools replace data collection and tabulation tasks, not the energy-diagnosis role. Auditors who diagnose problems and persuade owners become scarcer as productivity rises. Assistants limited to collecting data face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in HVAC, electrical engineering, or energy through a bachelor's degree. Gain experience with monitoring and modeling. Data-only work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop diagnostic skills early.
Advance from reading meters to diagnosing problems and negotiating retrofits. Learn AI tools and seek responsibility for complete projects.
Highlight field-survey and retrofit experience. Specify the building types you have assessed. Firms value reliable, practical work.
Do not assess candidates by credentials alone. Test whether they can diagnose problems. Core staff who persuade owners merit higher commissions.

ai_s7_trends: Smart meters expand while manual collection contracts.
Dual-carbon and energy-efficiency goals create opportunities.
Auditors who diagnose problems and persuade decision-makers become more sought after.

body: Energy Auditors lead energy-use assessments and efficiency diagnoses for buildings and equipment. They coordinate data collection, equipment inspections, and retrofit planning, use monitoring and modeling tools, issue audit reports, and track implementation.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Smart meters can collect data automatically, but Energy Auditors still decide where heat escapes, which upgrades pay off, and how to persuade owners.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代能源审计师，但会加速采集。智能表与 AI 分析把数据采集提速，审计师从「读表算数」挪向「现场判据、改造建议、经济权衡、业主沟通」。真正被挤掉的是只做数据采集的，有诊断力能说服人的更值钱。

能耗基线自动算
异常用能预警
报告自动生成

改造建议：取舍靠人定。
经济权衡：回报靠人算。
业主沟通：说服靠人。
安全平衡：边界靠人握。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的节能区——采集与报告被系统加速，但诊断与沟通还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「数据采集与制表」动作，不是「节能诊断」的岗位。有诊断力、能说服业主的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做采数的助理。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 暖通/电气/能源本科打底，在校多摸监测和建模。AI 时代纯采数在缩，早点练诊断。
从「读表」升级成「做诊断 + 谈改造」，学 AI 工具，争取负责项目。
突出踏勘和改造经验，写清做过哪些类型建筑。机构看重稳和实。
选人别只看证书，要看有没有诊断脑子。能说服业主的骨干，值得给高提成。

ai_s7_trends: 智能表普及，采集缩。
双碳与节能带来机会。
有诊断说服力的人更抢手。

body: 能源审计师主导建筑与设备的能耗测评与节能诊断，统筹跑数据、看设备和改方案，运用监测与建模手段，出具审计并跟进改造落地。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 智能表能自动采数，但哪处漏热、改哪最划算、业主怎么说服，还是审计师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: A work-order app can automate scheduling and dispatch, but a supervisor still needs to respond when a client is angry about an old stain.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 269,800 First Line Supervisors Of Housekeeping And Janitorial Workers employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 276,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 6,600 jobs, with roughly 33,000 openings each year. The median annual wage is about $47,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace housekeeping supervisors, but it will handle scheduling, attendance, and inspection records. Work-order systems assign tasks and retain photo evidence, shifting supervisors from notebooks toward monitoring exceptions, managing people, and resolving disruptions. Team leads who only complete forms face displacement, while people who allocate staff and calm clients become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Client repair requests create work orders directly through an app
Inspection routes adjust dynamically from soil and stain heatmaps
Short training videos and SOP delivery assist new-worker coaching
ai_s2_auto: Work-order systems automatically assign schedules and tasks
Automated records for inspection check-ins and photo evidence
Digital ledgers for supply requests and inventory
Usage data and wear alerts for cleaning equipment
ai_s3_list: On-site supervision and detail checks: machines do not capture the difference between acceptable and fully clean.
Staff allocation: people decide who covers an absence.
Complaints and emotions: machines cannot de-escalate an angry client.
Urgent sanitation incidents: people respond immediately to leaks or vomit.
Leadership and safety training: new workers need human coaching.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this career in the low-moderate AI exposure range for on-site management. Systems handle records and dispatch, while people retain site supervision and interpersonal coordination.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Systems replace form completion and task dispatch, not management of people and sites. Supervisors who allocate staff, control operations, and retain workers become more efficient with work-order systems. Team leads limited to notebooks face the most risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This career has a low entry barrier and room to advance, so do not avoid it because the work is dirty. Start with high school or vocational education, earn a property management credential while working, and progress from team lead to supervisor.
Advance from doing the work yourself to leading others. Learn work-order systems and complaint-resolution language, then pursue larger projects or facilities supervision.
Highlight scheduling, site inspection, and shift-lead experience. State how many people and how large a building you managed. Property employers value reliability under pressure.
Do not hire only for diligence; assess scheduling and on-site authority. Supervisors who lead shifts independently and calm complaints deserve management allowances.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Convert repair requests into work orders

ai_s7_trends: Work-order and inspection systems spread, shifting supervisors from forms toward exception monitoring and people management.
Specialized settings such as health care, senior care, and data centers increase demand for professional cleaning supervisors.
Outsourcing price pressure expands management scope, making supervision of multiple buildings common.

body: First Line Supervisors Of Housekeeping And Janitorial Workers lead teams in properties, hotels, and health care facilities. They implement inspection plans, assign tasks, manage supplies and equipment, and handle service complaints and sanitation incidents.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 工单 APP 能把排班派单做成自动按钮，但客户指着一块陈年污渍发火，还得主管过去鞠躬赔笑脸。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年主管工人在岗约 26.98 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 27.64 万人，净增约 0.66 万个岗位，年均产生约 3.30 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.75 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代保洁主管，但会接管排班、打卡和巡检记录这些管理动作。工单系统把任务自动派到人、拍照留痕，主管从「记本子」挪向「盯异常、管人、救火」。真正被挤掉的是只会填表不会带人的组长，能调度人手、能平息客诉的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 客户报修通过 APP 直接生成工单
巡检路线按脏污热力图动态优化
培训短视频与 SOP 推送辅助带新
满意度评分实时回传辅助管理
ai_s2_auto: 排班与派单的工单系统自动分配
巡检打卡与拍照留痕的自动化记录
物料申领与库存的数字化台账
清洁设备的使用数据与耗损预警
ai_s3_list: 现场督导与抠死角：机器拍不出「差一点」的质感。
人手调配：谁请假、谁顶岗要人临场决定。
客诉与情绪处理：甲方发火时机器接不住。
突发卫生事件处置：漏水呕吐要人立刻冲。
带人与安全培训：新人上手靠人带。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的现场管理区——系统能接管记录派单，但现场督导和人际协调留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「填表派单」动作，不是「管人管现场」的岗位。会调度、能压场、留得住人的主管，反而随工单系统变得更高效。怕的是只会记本子、不带人的老组长。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 这行起点低、能往上走，别嫌脏。高中或中专起，边干边考物业经理证，从组长熬到主管是踏实路径。
从「自己干」升级成「带人干」，学工单系统和客诉话术，争取管更大项目或转设施主管。
突出排班、巡场和带班经验，写清管过多少人、接过多大的楼。物业招聘看重稳和扛事。
招人别只看勤快，要看会不会排班和压场。能独立带班、会平息客诉的主管，值得给管理补贴。

ai_s7_trends: 工单与巡检系统普及，主管从填表转向盯异常和管人。
细分业态（医养、数据中心）对专业清洁主管需求上升。
外包压价下管理半径变大，一人管多楼成为常态。

body: 主管工人是保洁与门房主管在物业、酒店、医疗等场所带领保洁与门房团队，制定并执行清洁巡检计划，分配任务、管理物料设备、处理服务投诉与突发卫生事件。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate an optimal cut and scan internal flaws, but a worker's eyes and hands still decide how far to move the grinding wheel and whether the stone has achieved full brilliance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 35,100 workers in 2024, projected to fall to 33,200 by 2034. That is a net loss of about 1,900 jobs, with roughly 4,000 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $49,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Gem And Diamond Workers, but it will widen skill differences. AI and software take over cut planning, flaw scanning, and valuation, while mechanical cutting handles standard pieces. Fancy shapes, high-clarity cutting, and custom setting still depend on advanced craftspeople because machines cannot reproduce judgment at the scale of a millimeter.
ai_s2_accel: AI assists cutting-angle design to improve brilliance
Laser and mechanical cutting process standard pieces
Automated grading improves lab-grown diamond efficiency
3D-printed wax models accelerate custom jewelry prototypes
ai_s2_auto: Software calculates cutting plans and material yield
Instruments automatically scan and grade flaws
Digital systems manage orders, inventory, and valuation
Systems archive processing records and quality data
ai_s3_list: Cutting feel and judgment: angle, pressure, and stopping time come from extensive practice.
Steady hands and sharp eyes in setting: a small position or prong error under magnification can ruin the piece.
Fancy shapes and repairs: machines cannot standardize unusual forms or damaged-stone restoration.
Material understanding: cutting the same stone in a different direction can transform the result.
Loss and cost control: every cut affects value, and software cannot make the full craft judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score places this occupation in a low-moderate AI exposure range. Its limited desk work, including valuation, orders, and grading, is increasingly automated by software and instruments.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not equal high risk. Mechanization and AI target standard pieces, while fancy shapes, high-clarity cutting, and custom setting remain manual crafts. Low-end repetitive work faces pressure, while scarce advanced craftspeople gain value.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study jewelry processing or jewelry design and train at a reputable workshop or brand factory. Do not focus only on standard pieces. Practice fancy-shape cutting and setting to build toward advanced technician roles.
Take on fancy-shape stones, custom setting, and repairs, and learn laser and 3D-printing equipment. Income grows when you move from standard work into techniques others cannot perform.
Entry without experience can start through a grinding and polishing apprenticeship. Art or handcraft experience helps. List specific cutting processes, completed pieces, and loss rates on a resume.
Do not hire only for years worked. Evaluate fancy-piece capability and loss control. Craftspeople who perform high-clarity cutting and custom setting justify higher pay than assembly-line workers.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Optimizes cut plans and predicts brilliance

ai_s7_trends: Lab-grown diamonds and mechanical cutting expand mid- and low-market capacity. Standard-piece processing continues to mechanize, concentrating jobs in high-end fancy shapes and custom work.
Demand for custom jewelry and luxury repairs is growing, creating clear scarcity premiums for advanced setters and fancy-shape cutters.
AI and laser equipment assist advanced craftspeople and improve precision, while core techniques still depend on skilled hands.

body: Gem And Diamond Workers turn rough stones into finished gems. They cut diamonds, grind and polish gemstones, set stones, and engrave pieces. Precise cutting and craft skill increase value, making this a specialized jewelry occupation that relies heavily on handwork.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate an optimal cut and scan internal flaws, but a worker's eyes and hands still decide how far to move the grinding wheel and whether the stone has achieved full brilliance.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能算最优切工方案、能扫描内部瑕疵，但砂轮推到哪一毫米、火彩亮没亮出来，还得靠加工工的眼和手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年工人在岗约 3.51 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.32 万人，岗位净减约 0.19 万个，年均产生约 0.40 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.91 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代宝石加工工，但会拉大手艺分化。切工方案、瑕疵扫描、估价这些桌面活被 AI 和软件接手，机械切磨也吃掉标准规格件；但异形石、高净度切磨和定制镶嵌仍依赖高级工匠——放大镜下那一毫米的判断，机器学不会。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助设计切磨角度，提升出火率
激光切割与机械切磨处理标准规格件
培育钻石自动分级提升效率
3D 打印蜡模加速定制首饰打样
ai_s2_auto: 切工方案与出料率由软件自动计算
瑕疵扫描与分级用仪器自动检测
订单、库存与估价管理电子化
加工记录与质检数据自动归档
ai_s3_list: 切磨的手感与判断：角度、力度、停刀的时机，靠的是成千上万次的练习。
镶嵌的手稳眼细：放大镜下摆石位、调爪，一偏就是废件。
异形石与修复工艺：标准机磨不来的形状和残损修复，只能手工。
对石材特性的理解：同一颗石头，不同方向切效果天差地别。
损耗与成本控制：每一刀都算钱，这个账机器算不来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的桌面事务有限且正被自动化——估价、订单、分级都有软件和仪器代劳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。机械化和 AI 瞄准的是标准规格件，异形石、高净度切磨和定制镶嵌仍是手工的天下。真正被挤压的是低端重复加工，高级工匠反而因为稀缺更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选珠宝加工、首饰设计相关专业，进正规工坊或品牌工厂实习。别只学「标准件加工」，重点练异形切磨和镶嵌手艺，往高级技师方向走。
主动接异形石、定制镶嵌和修复的活，把激光、3D 打印这些新设备用起来。从「做标准件」升级为「做别人做不了的」，收入才能翻倍。
无经验可从打磨抛光学徒入行，最好有美术或手作基础。简历上多写「会哪些切磨工序、完成过多少件、损耗率多少」这类硬指标。
招加工工别只看「干得久」，要看异形件能力和损耗控制。能做高净度切磨和定制镶嵌的工匠，比只会流水线的工人值得高薪。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 最优切工方案、出火预测

ai_s6_tools.工具: 放大镜与显微观察设备

ai_s7_trends: 培育钻石与机械切磨扩大中低端产能，标准件加工持续机械化，加工工岗位向高端异形与定制集中。
定制珠宝与奢侈品修复需求增长，高级镶嵌师和异形切磨师稀缺溢价明显。
AI 与激光设备成为高级工匠的辅助工具，人机协同提高精度，但核心工艺仍靠人手。

body: 宝石与钻石加工工负责将原石加工为成品宝石，包括钻石切磨、宝石打磨抛光、镶嵌与雕刻，通过精准的切工与工艺提升宝石的价值，是珠宝产业中高度依赖手工技艺的专业岗位。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can list ten books in a second, but only a librarian who understands people notices that the reader actually needs the eleventh.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 142,100 librarians and media collections specialists employed in 2024, projected to reach 144,500 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 2,400 jobs, with roughly 13,500 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $64,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace librarians, but it will reshape the role. AI increasingly handles cataloging, basic research, and information organization, shifting librarians toward interpreting needs, assuring information quality, and designing services. AI provides a list of results; librarians judge which sources are credible and appropriate for the person in front of them.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted title selection and collection-demand forecasting
Generative research summaries and thematic reading lists
Automatic transcription for accessible reading and oral-history materials
ai_s2_auto: Automated basic cataloging and metadata entry
Assisted keyword research and source verification
Electronic lending, returns, and collection inventory
Reference chatbots handle common questions
ai_s3_list: Needs interpretation: uncover real intent within an ambiguous question.
Information quality control: judge source reliability and content quality.
Service design: organize resources into forms readers can use.
Collection development: understand people and books to build a living collection.
Instruction: teach readers to research and use information critically.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score makes librarianship a moderate AI-exposure occupation. AI is taking over standardized, repetitive information processing, but services are for people, so judgment and design remain human. It is a classic case of tasks being replaced while the occupation upgrades.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure is not a reason to stand still. Librarians who use AI research effectively and deliver data services are evolving from book custodians into information advisers, increasing both earnings and service value.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study library and information science with clear expectations. Traditional librarian roles are shrinking, while data management, information-literacy education, and subject services are hiring. Build a strong information-science foundation, add a specialty such as data, medicine, or law, and consider a master's degree to broaden opportunities beyond the humanities.

Add two capabilities quickly: digital tools beyond cataloging and research, including data analysis and database management; and deep knowledge in an industry such as medicine, law, or research services. A librarian who understands a field is more valuable than a generalist.

People with experience in information organization, content review, or knowledge management have an advantage when moving into libraries. Emphasize research skills and projects such as subject databases or research reports, and complete relevant library-science qualifications.

Libraries face growing recruitment difficulty. Relax strict library-science degree requirements and consider candidates from data, education, and content-operations backgrounds. Growth-oriented roles such as subject librarian and data-services specialist can attract younger workers.

ai_s7_trends: Librarians shift from managing books toward data and information services.
Public-library budgets face pressure, while academic and specialized libraries have steadier demand.
AI tools become routine in libraries, making information-literacy education a core skill.

body: Librarians and media collections specialists organize, manage, and provide access to library resources, including collection development and cataloging, reference and research services, reading programs and information-literacy education, and audio resources.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能一秒列出十本书，但「读者真正想找的可能是第十一本」，这一层只有懂人的馆员补得上。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年图书馆员与媒体馆藏专员在岗约 14.21 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 14.45 万人，净增约 0.24 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.35 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.43 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代图书馆员，但会重塑这个岗位：编目、基础检索、信息整理正在被 AI 接手，馆员的价值转向「解读需求、把关信息质量、设计服务」——AI 给的是结果清单，馆员判断哪些可信、哪些适合眼前这个人。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助选书与馆藏需求预测
生成式检索摘要与专题书单
数字人文项目中的文本挖掘工具
无障碍阅读与口述资料自动转录
ai_s2_auto: 基础编目与元数据录入自动化
关键词检索与文献查证辅助
借还书与馆藏盘点电子化
参考问答机器人处理常见咨询
ai_s3_list: 需求解读：从含糊问题里抓真实意图。
信息把关：判断来源可靠性与内容质量。
服务设计：把资源组织成读者用得上的形态。
馆藏策划：懂人懂书，做出有生命的馆藏。
教学引导：教读者检索、批判性使用信息。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明图书馆员是「中度 AI 曝光」的职业：标准化、重复性的信息处理活正在被接管，但服务对象是人，判断和设计还得靠人，属于「任务被替代、岗位在升级」的典型。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于躺平：会用好 AI 检索、会做数据服务的馆员，正在从「管书的人」变成「信息顾问」，收入和服务价值反而在涨。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 报图书情报要清醒：传统「图书馆员」岗位在收缩，但数据管理、信息素养教育、学科服务在招人。建议本科打好情报学基础，辅修一门专业方向（数据、医学、法律等），再读个硕士，就业面比纯文科宽得多。
抓紧补两项：一是数字工具，编目检索之外学会数据分析、数据库管理；二是面向一个行业深耕（医学、法律、科研服务等），做「懂行业的馆员」，比泛泛的图书馆员值钱。
有信息整理、内容审核、知识管理背景的人转图书馆有优势。求职时突出检索能力和项目案例（做过专题库、写过检索报告都算），并补修图书馆学相关资质。
图书馆招人越来越难，建议放宽「必须图书情报科班」的限制，向数据、教育、内容运营背景开放；用「学科馆员」「数据服务岗」这类有成长性的职位吸引年轻人。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 86,000 cabinetmakers and bench carpenters were employed in 2024, with employment projected to fall to 84,700 by 2034, a net loss of about 1,300 jobs. The occupation generates approximately 8,100 openings annually, and median annual pay was about $46,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace cabinetmakers and bench carpenters, but it will reshape their workflows by assigning repetitive, structured tasks to tools while people focus on judgment, responsibility, and creativity. Formulaic execution faces the greatest pressure, while craftspeople who understand real situations and make sound decisions become more valuable.

Second, high-value cabinetmaking judgment and accountability are becoming scarcer.
Third, cabinetmaking roles are evolving toward combinations of professional expertise and management or product skills.
